vlae.rede: The pronoun 'Sy' points back past 'hy' (Octavianus) to Kleopatra, named two sentences earlier, so a learner revising this block may stumble; 'Kleopatra en Antonius' would be clearer, but it adds a four-syllable word while the long-word share sits at 12.8% against a 13% limit, so it is flagged rather than proposed. The protected wording 'is albei in 30 v.C. dood' would stay untouched either way.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: het een van sy generaals, Ptolemeus, en dié se afstammelinge daar regeer
laat_vaar_vorige.na: het Ptolemeus, een van sy generaals, en later dié se afstammelinge daar regeer
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: As written, 'een van sy generaals, Ptolemeus, en dié se afstammelinge' can be misread as a list of three; leading with the name and marking the sequence makes it clear the descendants ruled after him.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original is a normal appositive that reads clearly, while the proposal adds 'later' and puts 'generaals' nearest to 'dié se', so the pronoun's antecedent becomes less clear.
